title: Recovery of Paid Reimbursements from Responsible Guests under Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) subrogation.** After paying a claim, Roamhaven pursues the responsible guest for the amount it paid where the level provides for recovery from the guest (every level does).

- Every amount recovered is booked against the claim.
- An amount recovered never exceeds the reimbursement paid on that claim, net of earlier recoveries.
- A recovery restores the plan-year aggregate.
- Recoveries never reach the host: the host was already paid, and a guest payment made after the reimbursement is a recovery, not a guest payment to the host.

## Illustration (hypothetical claim)

Roamhaven paid a reimbursement of 1200.00 on a claim. The guest later pays 500.00: this is booked as a recovery of 500.00 against the claim, not as a guest payment to the host, and it restores 500.00 of the plan-year aggregate. A second recovery on the same claim can be at most 700.00, the 1200.00 paid less the 500.00 already recovered.

## Before and after the reimbursement

| When the guest pays | How it is booked | Who it reaches |
|---|---|---|
| Before Roamhaven pays the claim | guest payment on the claim | credited to the host |
| After Roamhaven has paid the claim | recovery against the claim | stays with Roamhaven; never reaches the host |
